service_at_issue: Home health skilled nursing visits Apr 17 - Oct 13, 2007 (Part B)
outcome_note: Council reversed the ALJ, holding the intermittent skilled nursing visits (wound care, observation and assessment, care-plan management) were reasonable and necessary regardless of chronicity.
facts: The skilled nursing services were needed, first, to observe and assess the beneficiary’s wounds, from April 17, through at least the first week of June 2007, and as well, to provide appropriate wound care training.

He had a recurrence of urinary tract infection around mid-point during the six-month period at issue. He was hospitalized for several days in July 2007 for urosepsis and e.coli infection. He experienced another bout of urinary tract infection two months later. He experienced rectal bleeding more than once during the dates of service, and penile discharge (for which he was given prescription antibiotics).
